description: Source file implementing internal functions for audio sink management in the starboard platform, including initialization, fallback handling, and creation of audio sink objects.

classes.name: SbAudioSinkPrivate
classes.description: Namespace encapsulating internal management of audio sink types and creation functions.

methods.name: SbAudioSinkPrivate::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes fallback audio sink type and platform-specific setup.

methods.name: SbAudioSinkPrivate::TearDown
methods.description: Cleans up resources and platform-specific teardown.

methods.name: SbAudioSinkPrivate::SetPrimaryType
methods.description: Sets the primary audio sink type.

methods.name: SbAudioSinkPrivate::GetPrimaryType
methods.description: Returns the current primary audio sink type.

methods.name: SbAudioSinkPrivate::EnableFallbackToStub
methods.description: Enables fallback to stub audio sink type.

methods.name: SbAudioSinkPrivate::GetFallbackType
methods.description: Returns the fallback audio sink type if fallback is enabled.

methods.name: SbAudioSinkPrivate::GetPreferredType
methods.description: Determines and returns the preferred audio sink type based on command line switches and fallback status.

methods.name: SbAudioSinkPrivate::Create
methods.description: Creates an SbAudioSink object using preferred or fallback type, with validation and error handling.
